content.short: TonMobile provides anonymous international eSIMs and data plans payable with TON and USDT.
content.description: TonMobile is a specialized infrastructure service within the TON ecosystem that offers anonymous mobile data solutions for global travelers. Through its Telegram-based interface, users can purchase eSIMs and data plans for over 150 countries, paying seamlessly with Toncoin or USDT. TonMobile prioritizes privacy and convenience, eliminating the need for traditional identification or physical SIM cards. It is an essential utility for privacy-conscious users and frequent travelers who want to maintain decentralized connectivity while leveraging the efficiency of the TON blockchain for secure payments.
content.meta: Get anonymous global data with TonMobile eSIM. Pay with TON and travel freely on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
